title: Outline of U.S. History
coverage: Settlement, independence, constitutional formation, expansion, civil war, industrialization, reform, world wars, civil rights, conservative resurgence, and political change through the 2008 election

title: A History of England
coverage: Selected chapter-length transitions from Celtic and Roman Britain through state formation, conquest, reformation, civil war, constitutional settlement, industrial reform, empire, and the end of the Victorian era

title: UK Election Statistics: 1918-2023, A Long Century of Elections
coverage: The replacement of the Liberals by Labour, two-party dominance, later fragmentation, devolution, and the rise of smaller and regional parties

title: Germany: A Country Study
coverage: German unification, empire, world wars, Weimar collapse, Nazism, division, postwar party systems, reunification, and political realignment through 1995

title: Brazil: A Country Study
coverage: Indigenous and colonial Brazil, empire and republic, Vargas, military rule, redemocratization, party competition, and civil-military change through 1997
